title: Office Hours
summary: A little more guidance. A little less giving the answer away.

cover.alt: Illustrative Office Hours interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Office Hours workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: Students often need a useful next question rather than a complete worked solution.
story.built: A practice companion that responds with a hint, a question, and a small check for understanding.
story.aiUse: The model turns an instructor-written outline into progressively more specific hints.
story.humanDecisions: I defined the hint ladder and reviewed examples where the model accidentally revealed a solution.
story.limitations: This fictional project is a learning aid. It is not a course help channel or a grading system.
